query: failed TEE in 2 subjects and my scholarship might get affected, what now
department: Examination Department|School Academic Office (Course Coordinator / AR / DR)
next_action: Apply for the re-exam on the SAP student portal within the 3-day window and pay Rs. 1,000 per subject / Keep clear of F grades, misconduct and low attendance to stay eligible for awards
source_title: MPSTME Student Resource Book 2026 (Part I + Part II)
answer_facts: A failed student must take the re-examination held right after results; ICA marks are carried forward, and the online re-exam application on the SAP portal is mandatory. || Students with an F in any subject, a misconduct record or low attendance are automatically disqualified from the awards process.
